subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin support receiving every Space message, and should that be implemented with Workspace Events/Pub/Sub, user OAuth, or a different opt-in auth/subscription model?
rationale: Source review proves the current webhook/service-account path cannot satisfy the remaining request, but choosing broader Space visibility changes credential scope, consent, subscription ownership, and data exposure.

options.title: Design opt-in all-message ingestion
options.body: Define a Google Chat plugin design covering OAuth or Workspace Events scopes, subscription lifecycle, consent/allowlists, SecretRef handling, setup/doctor docs, and live Google Chat proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep mention-only webhooks
options.body: Document service-account webhooks as mention-only in Spaces and close or narrow all-message requests if maintainers do not want broader Space visibility in the bundled plugin.

options.title: Split into OAuth umbrella
options.body: Track the credential model under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9764 while keeping this issue as workflow context for all-message Space ingestion.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in all-message ingestion
recommendation.body: Define a Google Chat plugin design covering OAuth or Workspace Events scopes, subscription lifecycle, consent/allowlists, SecretRef handling, setup/doctor docs, and live Google Chat proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete has the strongest current routing signal from the prior review on this issue plus Google Chat thread/API commit history.
